reference: Published macOS 0.4.33 wheel, tokenizer and GPT-2 snapshot pinned by the prior plan; inference only, no training documents, published book scores, external or reserve text used as probe input.
cells: First letter is the recipient of the four scalar log radii, retaining every other tensor, recipe and trainability flag from fixed4 (F) or learned4 (L). Second letter gives the radius donor from the same data-order seed. FF and LL are untouched final checkpoints; same-source sham reconstruction must reproduce the exact original artifact ID. FL and LF are new inference artifacts, never trainer checkpoints.
primary: For each seed, target-token-weighted NLL over all eight authored continuations. Report FL-FF and LL-LF, learned instead of fixed radii on each recipient; lower is better. Also report LF-FF, LL-FL, LL-FF and interaction (LL-LF)-(FL-FF). Show all seed and prompt results, including reversals. The prespecified concordance requires both radius substitutions to lower NLL strictly at every seed.
generation_outcome: Record first differing generated token (one-based; null if sequences identical including termination) for FL vs FF, LL vs LF, LL vs FF and LL vs affine. Differences after a changed token are not same-context logit changes. No fluency or quality rating, sampling sweep, output controller or speed claim.

publication: Publish authored conditions, per-prompt scores, divergence positions, state/content hashes and all prespecified contrasts. Keep generated text/IDs, raw steps and parameter values private. Stop on the first error or timeout; do not project an incomplete matrix.
limits: Eight hand-authored probes are neither a random corpus nor a new held-out book. Matched weight substitutions test a direct effect within a finished model, not the training-time cause of improvement or general language quality. Three order seeds are not independent test sets.
